subject: gap and go on news with low float and high relative volume
claim: IF stock gaps up on news AND float_shares under 20 million AND rvol above 5 AND holds premarket_high at the open THEN LONG at the open

citation.quote: A stock gapping up on real news with a float under twenty million and relative volume above five. If it holds the premarket high at the open I go long, that is the gap and go.
